sections.heading: Why Choose It?
sections.text:
💰 Dual Energy Power Combo - Black Obsidian protects your energy while Pyrite attracts wealth, confidence, and success mindset in daily life.

 

 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 🧿 Protection from Negative Energy - Obsidian acts as a grounding shield, helping you stay stable, focused, and unaffected by negativity.

 

 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 ✨ Attracts Abundance & Opportunities - Pyrite is known as a “money magnet” crystal that supports growth, ambition, and forward movement.

 

 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 🎯 Designed for Daily Success Mindset - A balanced bracelet made for people who want clarity, confidence, and consistent progress.

sections.heading: How to wear ?
sections.text:
• Put the bracelet on your wrist in the morning and keep it with you throughout the day—at work, while travelling, or during regular activities.
• The Pyrite side supports confidence and action, while the Black Obsidian side helps you stay grounded—wear it as is without overthinking placement.
• Keep it on during meetings, decisions, or busy days when you need both clarity and stability.
• Start wearing the Richie Rich Half N Half Bracelet on Thursday morning for prosperity and growth energy.
• When not in use, keep it in a clean, dry place to maintain its quality.
• Wipe gently with a soft cloth and avoid water or harsh chemicals.

 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Studd Muffyn brings you the Riche Rich Bracelet, a powerful blend of Obsidian + Pyrite beads, thoughtfully designed by The Pyrite Man of India, Paras Tomar. This isn’t just jewelry—it’s a combination of protection and prosperity energy crafted for everyday wear.

Black Obsidian works like a protective shield, helping you stay grounded while keeping negativity and unwanted energetic influences away from your space. On the other side, Pyrite, often known as the “money magnet,” is linked with attracting wealth, opportunities, and a success-driven mindset. It’s not only about financial growth—it also represents confidence, recognition, and forward movement in life.

Together, this combination creates a strong balance—one protects your energy, the other pushes your ambition forward. That’s why this bracelet has become one of the most trusted crystal designs, with 2+ million units sold and over 1+ million users worldwide.

Each piece is made using authentic and tested crystals. The design is part of a collection that is widely recognized as India’s Most-Loved Crystal Bracelet Combo.

Get ready to be called "Riche Rich"😉

Kindly note that images are just a graphical representation of crystals. Size, Shape and Colour may vary at the time of delivery.

 FAQ
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 1. Is it made from real crystals?

Yes, each bracelet is handcrafted using authentic, lab-tested Obsidian and Pyrite crystals.

2. Who can wear the Riche Rich Bracelet?

It can be worn by anyone seeking protection, luck, and prosperity — suitable for both men and women.

3. On which hand should I wear it?

Wear on your left hand to absorb positive energy and block negativity.

4. Can I wear it daily?

Absolutely! The bracelet is designed for everyday use and pairs well with any outfit.

5. How do I cleanse my bracelet?

You can cleanse it using selenite crystal recharging plate or keep it under moonlight.
